source_title: Kredit.Pe × YES BANK Max RuPay Credit Card - Another Useless Card - Desidime
source_excerpt: ﻿Kredit.Pe has launched a new lifetime-free RuPay credit card with YES BANK, advertising up to 5% cashback on almost everything. (Jyada khush mat ho abhi se ) 💳 What They're Advertising: 5% cashback on eligible online & offline spends 3% on UPI spends up to ₹20K/month 5% on UPI spends above ₹20K/month ₹1,000 joining & welcome cashback Up to 20% off flight vouchers No joining or annual fees 🤡 Now Comes the Real Joke!What's the point of earning 5% cashback if redeeming it is another headache?❌ No straightforward cashback statement credit❌ Premium voucher charges on selected shopping vouchers❌ Additional cashback redemption charges❌ Forced into Kredit.Pe's limited redemption ecosystem❌ Actual savings can be significantly lower than advertisedAnd the new card's exact cashback caps and redemption charges aren't even clearly established yet.5% cashback in advertisements, a headache at redemption.Kredit.Pe's existing redemption model is already disappointing. Launching another card with flashy cashback numbers doesn't fix that.A shitty redemption system can make even a 5% cashback card useless.👎 My recommendation: SKIP IT. Plenty of better cashback cards offer rewards without making redemption a puzzle.
